newsitem.title: USA: Possis Medical launches AngioJet program.
newsitem.headline: Possis Medical launches AngioJet program.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Wednesday it launched a sales program for its AngioJet Rapid Thrombectomy System, used to treat heart attack victims.

The company also announced it recently shipped AngioJet Drive Units to independent distributors in Italy, Saudi Arabia, Russia and Portugal. Regulators in Australia also approved the AngioJet System with no restrictions, Possis Medical said.
Possis Medical develops cardiovascular medical devices.
Its shares were off 1/4 Wednesday at 13.
